Somerset Capital Management Llp increased its stake in Netease Inc (NTES) by 184.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 199,732 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $68.92M, up from 70,282 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Somerset Capital Management Llp who had been investing in Netease Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $32.73B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.18% or $5.56 $249.21. About 1.10M shares traded. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) has declined 2.94% since May 4, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.49% the S&P500.
